title: WebDesk Growth Dashboard — Background Job Record
description: The durable Postgres record every background job (Vercel Queues/Workflows/Cron-triggered) must conform to, per knowledge/04-serverless-queues-workflows-and-cron.md. There is no in-process job state in this architecture — this record IS the job's state. No in-process lock may substitute for locked_until/lock_owner below.

job_id.description: Stable job ID, assigned at creation, independent of any queue-provider-internal message ID.

project_id.description: Project-scope key (this project's equivalent of the base skill's tenant_id — see knowledge/10-data-ownership-and-audit.md).

idempotency_key.description: The natural key this job upserts on. External-system ID for sync-adjacent work; a dashboard-internal action+actor+target key for UI-triggered actions (gap-analysis.md item 5's internal-action idempotency case). Enforced as a unique constraint at the database level, not only in application code.

trigger.description: What caused this job record to be created or re-attempted.

status.description: Current job status. 'dead_letter' is the terminal state for an exhausted-retry job, per NODE-101 (capped retries, never unbounded).

attempt_count.description: Number of attempts made so far.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum duration a single attempt is allowed, consistent with the invoking Vercel Function's own platform timeout.

failure_classification.description: Mirrors nodejs/knowledge/integration/03-rate-limits-and-backoff.md's isRetryable distinction — a 429/503/timeout is retryable, a 400/validation error is terminal and must not burn retry attempts.

progress.description: Watermark/cursor/step-index, advanced only after durable persistence of the corresponding work.

lock.description: Overlapping-run prevention. Backed by this row (Postgres) or a Redis lock referenced here — never an in-process lock (knowledge/04's 'no in-process lock may be treated as durable' rule).

cancellable.description: Whether this job, in its current state, can be safely cancelled (false once it has begun an irreversible external side effect).

manual_retry_available.description: Whether an operator can trigger a retry from the dashboard for this job in its current status.

audit_context_id.description: Links to the audit_events entry for this job's creation/terminal outcome, per knowledge/10-data-ownership-and-audit.md.
